text:
the tree ha entrado for my hands,

the savia ha subido for my brazos,

the tree ha crecido in my pecho –

toward abajo,

the ramas salen of mí, as brazos.


tree eres,

musgo eres,


and the violetas in the wind.

a girl – tan high- eres,

And for the mundo all esto is a delirio.

translation.title: the tree ha entrado for my hands...
